# The Canggupedia

> Your ultimate insider guide to the best restaurants, bars, wellness spots, and events in Canggu and Uluwatu, Bali.

## About

The Canggupedia is a curated venue directory for two of Bali's most popular areas: Canggu and Uluwatu. We cover food & dining, hangout spots (bars & parties), wellness & fitness, and family-friendly activities. The site also lists upcoming events, daily promos, and happy hour deals.

## Content Structure

- `/` — Home page with destination picker (Canggu or Uluwatu)
- `/canggu` — Canggu area categories
- `/canggu/food` — Restaurants and cafes in Canggu (brunch, dinner, healthy, authentic)
- `/canggu/hangout` — Bars and party venues in Canggu
- `/canggu/wellness` — Gyms, yoga, boxing, pilates, spas in Canggu
- `/canggu/fun-family` — Family activities in Canggu (waterparks, zoos, activities)
- `/uluwatu` — Uluwatu area categories
- `/uluwatu/food` — Restaurants and cafes in Uluwatu
- `/uluwatu/hangout` — Bars and party venues in Uluwatu
- `/uluwatu/wellness` — Wellness and fitness in Uluwatu
- `/uluwatu/fun-family` — Family activities in Uluwatu
- `/events` — Upcoming events, parties, and festivals
- `/happy-hour` — Happy hour deals across venues
- `/daily-promos` — Special daily promotions
- `/about-us` — About The Canggupedia team
- `/contact` — Contact form

## Venue Information

Each venue listing includes: name, description, category, subcategory, location (Canggu or Uluwatu), Google Maps link, Instagram link, opening hours, price range, and optional table booking/guestlist/ticket links.
